summary: Re-ran the three suite failures live (human not busy). The Emotes test passes alone (order effect in the full suite). All three Parade tests fail when run alone, so the parade is really broken. I did not add new tests or play the new beach.

failures.what: Parade: followers do not stay with Sprout, so the parade party and the cairn parade never happen
failures.steps: live_tests("Parade") with the game idle: Sprout leads two followers (Pinchy, Cumulus) 7-10 m on open ground
failures.expected: A curious critter joins, three followers at the lantern turn into a dance ring, and at the cairn each fetches a pebble
failures.actual: 'Parade' fails with: nobody joined (walked 10.6 m to Pickles, now 14.7 m, fish, followers Pinchy, Cumulus). 'Parade party' fails with: ring never started dancing. 'Parade at the cairn' fails with: parade did not go fetch stones (Sprout 0.8 m away). The suite run also failed with 'no dance ring ... (now 0.6 m, followers 0)', so followers are lost. Likely tied to the s41 changes (new fishing spot, beach beachcomb/sunbathe goals, cottage turned) taking the followers or blocking the walk. Not confirmed.

failures.what: Emotes test fails only in the full suite: 'no creature on screen'
failures.steps: Run the whole suite; the Emotes test runs after other tests
failures.expected: A creature is on screen so the emote can be checked
failures.actual: Passes when run alone (8.2 s). Fails in the suite with 'no creature on screen', so state left by an earlier test (camera subject, a sleeping or beachcombing creature) probably causes it.
